title: Air Traffic Control Games for Android (Arcade, Radar, Tycoon)
h1: Air traffic control games for Android: the main types and what to play
description: Android ATC games come in three kinds: arcade route drawing, radar approach sims and airport tycoons. Here is how they differ and which games exist.

title: Double Elimination Bracket Explained (with 8-Team Example)
description: In double elimination a team is out after two losses. N teams play 2N-2 games, or 2N-1 if the grand final is reset. How the losers bracket works.

title: How Many Games Are in a Tournament? Formulas and Table
h1: How many games are in a tournament?
description: Single elimination: N-1 games. Double elimination: 2N-2 or 2N-1. Round robin: N(N-1)/2. Swiss: rounds × N/2. Table for 4 to 32 teams.

title: How to Keep Livestock Health Records (What to Record and Why)
h1: How to keep livestock health records
description: Log each animal's ID and every treatment: product, batch, dose, date, who gave it and withdrawal end date. UK and EU rules: keep 5 years or more.

title: How to Learn Morse Code by Ear (Koch, Farnsworth, Daily Plan)
h1: How to learn Morse code by ear
description: Learn Morse by sound, not a chart: hear characters at 15 to 20 WPM, start with two (Koch method), add one at 90% accuracy, practice daily.

title: How to Organize a Round Robin Tournament (Schedule, Byes)
h1: How to organize a round robin tournament
description: In a round robin of N teams everyone plays everyone: N(N-1)/2 games in N-1 rounds (N rounds if odd). How to schedule, handle byes and break ties.

title: How to Seed a Tournament Bracket (Order, Byes, Examples)
h1: How to seed a tournament bracket
description: Rank the teams, then pair 1 vs 16, 8 vs 9, 4 vs 13 and so on, so top seeds meet last. Byes = next power of two minus teams, given to top seeds.

title: Satisfying Cleaning Games With No Timers (Calm, Offline)
h1: Satisfying cleaning games without timers or pressure
description: Calm cleaning and restoration games have no timers, lives or energy. What makes them satisfying, how to spot pressure, and games to try on Android.

title: How to Explain Soccer Plays With a Tactics Board
h1: How to use a soccer tactics board to explain plays
description: Show one idea per board, move it step by step, keep the same arrows, then practice it on the field. Formations, pressing, set pieces, a sample plan.

title: Swiss System Tournament Explained (Pairing, Rounds, Buchholz)
description: In a Swiss tournament players with equal scores meet each round, nobody plays twice and nobody is eliminated. About log2 N rounds, Buchholz breaks ties.

title: Voltage Drop Calculation Explained (Formula and Worked Example)
description: Single-phase VD = 2 × K × I × L ÷ CM; three-phase uses 1.732. K is 12.9 for copper, 21.2 for aluminum. Worked examples in AWG and mm².
